plan.notes: Source: TMCC official catalog 'Secondary Education, AS' (https://catalog.tmcc.edu/degrees-certificates/secondary-education-as/), 'Recommended Course Schedule' plan-of-study grid (Secondary Education Career Map), hand-transcribed 2026-10-02. The plan footnotes numbered 4 and 5 in the schedule grid are not defined on this page — those slots are modeled as choice slots with an honest 'not defined on this page; see advisor' note. Students also select a 'teaching major' and complete some coursework prior to transfer. Designated as a university transfer program substantially meeting the first two years of study for B.S. secondary education majors at UNR. Per-course prerequisites are not listed in the schedule grid.
